name: auth.users
comment: Auth: Stores user login data within a secure schema.

name: auth.refresh_tokens
comment: Auth: Store of tokens used to refresh JWT tokens once they expire.

name: auth.instances
comment: Auth: Manages users across multiple sites.

name: auth.audit_log_entries
comment: Auth: Audit trail for user actions.

name: auth.schema_migrations
comment: Auth: Manages updates to the auth system.

name: auth.identities
comment: Auth: Stores identities associated to a user.

name: auth.sessions
comment: Auth: Stores session data associated to a user.

name: auth.mfa_factors
comment: auth: stores metadata about factors

name: auth.mfa_challenges
comment: auth: stores metadata about challenge requests made

name: auth.mfa_amr_claims
comment: auth: stores authenticator method reference claims for multi factor authentication

name: auth.sso_providers
comment: Auth: Manages SSO identity provider information; see saml_providers for SAML.

name: auth.sso_domains
comment: Auth: Manages SSO email address domain mapping to an SSO Identity Provider.

name: auth.saml_providers
comment: Auth: Manages SAML Identity Provider connections.

name: auth.saml_relay_states
comment: Auth: Contains SAML Relay State information for each Service Provider initiated login.

name: auth.flow_state
comment: Stores metadata for all OAuth/SSO login flows

name: auth.oauth_client_states
comment: Stores OAuth states for third-party provider authentication flows where Supabase acts as the OAuth client.

name: public.rona_mail_messages
comment: RONA Trade server-side mail mirror. No anon/authenticated access; service_role only.

name: public.rona_mail_sync_state
comment: IMAP synchronization cursor/state for RONA Trade mail bridge.

name: public.rona_mail_outbox
comment: Server-side SMTP outbox for RONA Trade mail bridge. Messages are sent by the bridge worker.

name: portal_private.portal_users
comment: Portal identity profile. auth_user_id remains nullable until a later Auth gate.

name: portal_private.portal_user_roles
comment: Server-authoritative role assignments; JWT/frontend claims are not the authority.

name: portal_private.portal_sessions_control
comment: Server-side revoke/block foundation; does not store passwords.

name: portal_private.contract_external_references
comment: Append-preserving external contract references. Historical/payment references are never silently rewritten.

name: portal_private.client_user_bindings
comment: Fail-closed User to Client to Contract authorization bindings. No binding means no access.

name: portal_private.client_user_deal_grants
comment: Optional explicit Deal-level restriction; Deal scope is normalized, never stored as an ID array.

name: portal_private.agent_persons
comment: Agent natural person authority. Never merged with the agent legal entity.

name: portal_private.agent_legal_entities
comment: Agent legal entity authority. Separate from natural-person identity.

name: portal_private.agent_client_assignments
comment: Agent business assignment independent of Portal login: Agent Person + Agent Legal Entity -> Client.

name: portal_private.agent_deal_terms
comment: Server-authoritative commercial term scope for an assigned agent and Deal.

name: portal_private.document_versions
comment: Versioned signed-document metadata. Hash/path/version/source fields are immutable after insert; only authority/current/effective lineage state may advance.

name: portal_private.payment_references
comment: Append-preserved bank/contract/invoice/historical payment references.

name: portal_private.rail_documents
comment: Rail document may exist without an authoritative Shipment; no automatic Shipment creation is implied.

name: portal_private.rail_wagons
comment: Client exposure must traverse an authoritative Shipment to Deal scope; unscoped rail records remain server-only.

name: portal_private.client_applications
comment: Application authority. Submission/acceptance never auto-creates a Deal; linked_deal_key is populated only after explicit Deal registration.

name: portal_private.news_reads
comment: Server-authoritative read state; unread is not sourced from browser localStorage.

name: portal_private.agent_settlements
comment: Settlement authority separates projected, verified, approved, payable-confirmed and paid states.

name: portal_private.agent_settlement_events
comment: Append-only settlement state evidence trail.

name: portal_private.import_batches
comment: Idempotent, traceable canonical import batch authority. Phase 3 creates foundation only; no production canonical rows are imported.

name: portal_private.source_objects
comment: Immutable source-object snapshot and provenance record.

name: portal_private.audit_events
comment: Append-only server audit trail; ordinary Admin workflows must never update or delete audit history.

name: portal_private.rail_monitoring_targets
comment: Server-only Movizor monitoring registry. A wagon may be monitored only after authoritative Wagon -> Shipment -> Deal -> Client binding; no cron is activated by this migration.

name: portal_private.rail_provider_raw_responses
comment: Immutable raw provider response layer. Credentials and API keys must never be stored in request_metadata or payload columns.

name: portal_private.rail_movement_events
comment: Normalized RONA Rail movement events from MOVIZOR. These events never overwrite authoritative route, Shipment, Deal, Client, GU-12 or SMGS master-data.

name: portal_private.rail_authority_conflicts
comment: Provider/master-data conflicts are recorded as TO_VERIFY/HOLD and require reconciliation; silent overwrite is prohibited.

name: portal_private.storage_objects
comment: Server-authoritative metadata for the private rona-portal-private bucket. Browser users never receive direct table authority; object delivery is via server-authorized short-lived signed URLs.

name: portal_private.storage_access_events
comment: Append-only audit of Portal storage authorization and delivery actions.

name: portal_private.portal_api_request_events
comment: Append-only server API audit. Authorization tokens and provider secrets must never be written to metadata.

name: portal_private.rail_provider_runtime_control
comment: Fail-closed Movizor runtime gate. Credentials themselves are never stored here; only server-managed readiness state. Default is DISABLED.

name: portal_private.agent_user_relation_control
comment: Server-only pre-auth/source relation state. NULL portal_user_id and NOT ESTABLISHED/TO_VERIFY are valid and grant no Portal access.

name: portal_private.portal_reverse_events
comment: Phase 5C server-side reverse Portal event inbox. Frontend actions become auditable requests and never mutate canonical authority fields directly.

name: portal_private.portal_reverse_event_attempts
comment: Append-only processing/retry history for reverse Portal events.

name: portal_private.mcp_gateway_config
comment: STEP 2B-1D role-bound remote MCP gateway config. Role is server-side and cannot be selected by tool arguments.

name: portal_private.mcp_gateway_request_events
comment: Append-only MCP transport audit correlated with portal_private.ai_read_access_events by backend_request_id/correlation_id.

name: portal_private.client_user_binding_profiles
comment: Administrator-controlled non-authoritative display/contact metadata for client access bindings. Access itself remains governed by client_user_bindings, portal_user_roles and server signed-contract gates.

name: portal_private.client_user_pending_company_bindings
comment: Administrator-created Client Portal company association pending a confirmed signed contract; grants no client data access by itself.

name: portal_private.telegram_market_documents
comment: Read-only Telegram market-source archive for Commercial Director analytics. Original files remain private and are never client-published by this table.

name: portal_private.owner_claims
comment: Authoritative Admin Portal claims registry. Legal AI analysis is carried through immutable ai_coordination_records; authoritative claim status remains ADMIN-controlled.

name: portal_private.owner_price_change_proposals
comment: Operations-originated price change proposals. No external price changes until the Admin owner applies the proposal.

name: portal_private.admin_payments_v7_provider_readiness
comment: Infrastructure activation/readiness state for optional Admin Payments V7 providers. This is not a Deal or Payment lifecycle state.

name: portal_private.finance_reconciliation_difference_publications_v1
comment: Append-only Finance-owned publication channel for the already calculated reconciliation difference. This table stores Finance output only; it does not calculate the metric.

name: portal_private.finance_reconciliation_difference_components_v1
comment: Append-only source-locked primary currency breakdown for a Finance reconciliation difference publication. Components are published Finance facts; no cross-currency calculation occurs here.

name: portal_private.finance_cash_statement_sources_v1
comment: Append-only Finance-owned source projection of authoritative bank statement balances for Admin Cash. No deal/business data is mutated.

name: portal_private.finance_cash_operations_v1
comment: Append-only Finance-classified bank operation projection for Admin Cash. External inflow/payment are mutually exclusive; FX and own-account movements are separate.

name: portal_private.finance_counterparty_identities_v1
comment: Finance counterparty identity-resolution registry only. It does not create or mutate business master entities; each identity is anchored to authoritative Client/Payment/Contract/Bank source evidence.

name: portal_private.rail_xlsx_dislocation_events_v1
comment: Immutable source-locked XLSX dislocation evidence. source locator = source object + sheet + row. Separate from MOVIZOR history.

name: portal_private.rail_xlsx_source_receipts_v1
comment: Append-only receipts for generic Rail AI XLSX source capture. Multiple filenames may reference one SHA-256 canonical source.
